item.title: ‘My Apple Watch is going to hate this’: Our wearables are making us anxious and obsessive — Here’s what we can all do about it
item.description: Wearables are designed to create healthy habits, but what happens when they end up reinforcing unhealthy behavior?

item.title: Dynaudio's wild soundbar with moving 'kinetic fins' is one of the most impressive I've ever seen — I spoke to the company's CCO about building a luxe soundbar for giant TVs and its impressive 24-driver design
item.description: I tried Dynaudio’s huge soundbar with moving wooden fins, and was wowed by its immense power and scale.

item.title: I watched Spider-Man: Brand New Day in Dolby Cinema — and the sound stole the show
item.description: I saw Spider-Man: Brand New Day in Dolby Cinema and was blown away by its immersive picture and especially its powerful, spatial Dolby Atmos sound.

item.title: The US Navy used a swarm of drone boats to seize $81 million worth of cocaine in the Caribbean
item.description: Two Saildrone Voyager vessels tracked suspected drug traffickers, enabling the US Navy to seize cocaine worth more than $81 million.
